abstract: Maintains banquet hall dining seating capacity records and food service credentials
system_message:
You are the Hospitality & Catering Manager (HOSP), responsible for maintaining banquet hall dining seating capacity records, food service credentials, and on-site culinary production assessments.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains banquet hall dining seating capacity records and food service credentials（BANQ）
information_points.content:
HOSP-BANQ-1ZB：Grand ballroom floor plan approval records show that the banquet dining capacity of Rhineland Maritime Exhibition Centre is 2000 seats across its unobstructed banquet hall area under standard egress rules.
HOSP-BANQ-HEK：According to the grand ballroom floor plan approval for unobstructed banquet hall floor area under standard egress rules, Bavaria Metropolitan Congress Park has a banquet dining capacity of 2800 seats.
HOSP-BANQ-Z3U：Weserfront Convention & Event Forum provides a banquet dining capacity of 2400 seats based on the approved grand ballroom floor plan for unobstructed banquet hall space under standard egress regulations.

information_points.title: On-site culinary production（KITCH）
information_points.content:
HOSP-KITCH-XXO：A catering facilities assessment of the central production galley at Bavaria Metropolitan Congress Park indicates an on-site plating kitchen throughput of 800 meals/h during peak hot meal dispatch.
HOSP-KITCH-BIY：For Weserfront Convention & Event Forum, the catering facilities assessment evaluates the central production galley peak hot meal dispatch at an on-site plating kitchen throughput of 1200 meals/h.
HOSP-KITCH-Y4O：The central production galley catering assessment for Rhineland Maritime Exhibition Centre records an on-site plating kitchen throughput of 1600 meals/h at peak hot meal dispatch capacity.
